# Fixture Provenance Report

The eight agricultural fixtures are references to immutable, locally available,
non-provisional development-validation records. Their file hashes exactly match
the existing split manifests. They are not copied into this repository.

The four sources are Mendeley Data datasets recorded by earlier AgrowAI audits
as CC BY 4.0. Dataset DOI and archive hashes are recorded in
`FIXTURE_MANIFEST.json`.

Disease folder labels are not treated as independent expert confirmation.
Consequently, the diseased fixtures may validate routing or safe abstention but
must not be used to claim diagnostic correctness.

All agricultural labels in this package remain:
`VERIFY_AGAINST_OFFICIAL_SOURCE`.

No sealed or provisional-test image was opened or referenced.
